title: The Yoga Sadhana That Brings God’s Love and Bliss | Sri Mrinalini Mata

# The Yoga Sadhana That Brings God’s Love and Bliss

### Sri Mrinalini Mata • Self-Realization Fellowship

Welcome and loving blessings. Yoga is not merely a set of physical exercises; it is the ultimate science of union with the Infinite. The heart of our path is "sadhana"—our daily devotional practice that connects the drop of our soul with the vast ocean of God's love and bliss.

### The Heart of Loving Sadhana

When we sit for meditation, we should not do so with a cold or dry attitude. View your practice as a sweet reunion with your Creator, the Father, Mother, and most Beloved of your soul. Pray with deep, intense yearning, refusing to get discouraged if He is silent.

### Overcoming Hurdles with Devotion

Every small effort you put forth carries tremendous power. The Guru is always sitting beside you, whispering encouragement to keep you moving forward. Dedicate your actions to Him, and let your heart overflow with His joy.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Heartfelt Chanting:** Spend a few minutes chanting before your meditation to soften the mind.
* **Sit Up Straight:** Maintain an open chest and straight spine to foster devotion and concentration.
* **Keep Seeking:** Pray with absolute sincerity, saying: "Lord, take my life and make it Thine."
* **Radiate Love:** Let your actions reflect the love you receive in your silent meditation seat.

May you forever dwell in His sweet bliss. Jai Guru! Jai Ma!
rawText: Sadhana is our personal, devotional communion with the Divine. By practicing meditation with heart-felt longing, we dissolve ego-separation and receive His sweet bliss...
